# first-setup-prototype journal replayed by setup, crashed before start
# each launchctl call, then the state of the files as it was asked
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=present com.agent-skills.skill-runs-upload=absent own=present
print gui/UID/com.agent-skills.skill-runs-upload  |  journal=present com.agent-skills.skill-runs-upload=present own=absent
bootstrap gui/UID @USER_HOME@/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agent-skills.skill-runs-upload.plist  |  journal=present com.agent-skills.skill-runs-upload=present own=absent
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=absent com.agent-skills.skill-runs-upload=present own=absent
# exit 1, end: journal=absent com.agent-skills.skill-runs-upload=present own=absent
